sentence_1_it: Attenzione! Ci sono cinque mucche sovietiche affamate in giardino!

sentence_2_en: Communism was the political system in the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, but that stopped in 1993.
sentence_3_it: U.R.S.S. significa Unione delle Repubbliche Socialiste Sovietiche.
sentence_3_en: USSR stands for Union of Soviet Socialist Republics.
